summary: Workflows chain job templates or workflow templates (and project or inventory syncs) as graph nodes with admin and execute permissions; launches save a copy of the graph, nodes can carry job_type, job_tags, skip_tags and limit, and templates prompting for credential or inventory without defaults cannot be included.
questions: What permissions do workflows have in automation controller?
Can a job template be used twice in the same workflow?
Why can't I add a job template that prompts for inventory to a workflow?
Does editing a workflow affect a running workflow job?
